description: Codex: Orks (11e) UNBRIDLED CARNAGE (Green Tide) through the real unit_selected_to_fight window on the Orks' own turn. Fixture ork11e_orks_active (P1 Orks active), detachment switched to Green Tide (setup privilege, stratagems reloaded). Setup-only privileges during the Orks' Charge phase: Boyz B (+ attached Warboss) are marked as having made a charge move (charged_this_turn + Fights First); Custodian Guard A's wounds inflated; auto wound allocation for the defender. The Ork player clicks the Boyz in the fighter picker; the window shows UNBRIDLED CARNAGE with an enabled Use button; a real click spends 1 CP and gives the Boyz AND the attached Warboss +1 A on their melee weapons; the fight then resolves through the attack dialog + dock. The +1 A is proven on the live board: the melee resolver's attack count for the Boyz' Choppa is exactly one die per swinging model higher with the stratagem than without (same seed, same board).

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Boyz made a charge move this turn

steps.equals: Boyz has been selected to fight

steps.comment: +1 A per swinging model on the live board (same seed)
